cards.title: Photon probabilities and equal-time factorial correlations

source_refs.value: Main Analytical results and Numerical results

cards.latex: P(n)=\langle n|\rho_{ss}|n\rangle,\quad \bar n=\sum_n nP(n),\quad g^{(m)}(0)=\frac{\sum_n n(n-1)\cdots(n-m+1)P(n)}{\bar n^m}

checks.reason: The paper defines P(n), mean photon number and g^(m) through normally ordered moments.
a†m a^m is diagonal in the Fock basis with falling-factorial eigenvalue n!/(n-m)! .
The converged density matrix is Hermitian, trace one and has nonnegative diagonal probabilities within numerical tolerance.

cards.title: Weak-drive analytic g2 and g3 references

checks.reason: The g2 formula is Main Eq. (7); the g3 form is stated and derived in the Supplement.
Substitution of the weak-drive amplitudes C1, C2 and C3 into factorial moments cancels drive powers and yields the displayed ratios.
For U=0 both expressions reduce to one, the coherent-state value.

cards.title: Photon-blockade, tunneling and Poisson-deviation criteria
cards.latex: f=e^{-\bar n},\quad 2PB:\quad g^{(3)}<f,\quad g^{(2)}\ge f+\bar n g^{(3)},\qquad \delta P_n=\frac{P(n)-e^{-\bar n}\bar n^n/n!}{e^{-\bar n}\bar n^n/n!}

checks.reason: The 2PB inequalities and relative Poisson deviations are stated explicitly in the Letter and Supplement.
For a coherent Poisson distribution every delta P_n is zero and all normalized factorial correlations equal one.
At paper parameters k=2.5, positive shift satisfies 2PB while the negative-shift branch has g2 and g3 much greater than one, matching the claimed PIT direction.

cards.title: Column-vectorized Liouvillian steady-state system
cards.latex: \mathcal L=-i(I\otimes H-H^T\otimes I)+\gamma[a^*\otimes a-\tfrac12(I\otimes a^\dagger a+(a^\dagger a)^T\otimes I)]

checks.reason: The starting operator equation is exactly Main Eq. (8); vectorization is an implementation identity rather than an imported author method.
Column stacking uses vec(A rho B)=(B^T tensor A)vec(rho), yielding every displayed Kronecker term.
A direct paper-parameter probe gives g2=0.001025 and 662.588 at k=1.5, consistent with the reported approximately 0.001 and 673.
